Nearly $2 billion in crypto bets got force-closed this weekend.
Bitcoin slid on Saturday, Nov 14, 2026, then hit a four-month low near $62,000 in Asian trading Sunday (Bloomberg).
Coinglass counted about $2 billion in crypto liquidations in 24 hours, mostly leveraged bullish bets. Analysts cite rate-hike bets, a break below bitcoin's 200-day average, and outflows from US spot bitcoin funds, including $1.28 billion in the week to Nov 6 (SoSoValue data via The Block).
Our math: with $1,000 of your own money in a $10,000 bet, a 10% drop wipes out your stake. Sunday's low is roughly half bitcoin's record of about $126,000 from Oct 2025.
Sources: Bloomberg, Cointelegraph, Investing.com, The Block, Coinglass and SoSoValue data (Nov 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
